h: Shabbos Meals Restore the Crowns Given at Sinai

p: Now at the time of the giving of the Torah,
when Yisrael put "we will do" before "we will hear"
And it is stated from the holy Arizal
(בִּפְרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שַׁעַר הַשַּׁבָּת פֶּרֶק ח)
(in Pri Etz Chaim, Sha'ar HaShabbos chapter 8)
as stated in the Gemara (Shabbos there, 88a),
on Shabbos he returns them to Yisrael.
here in the holy Zohar it is written first,
and knocks upon its leaves…" and so on,
"and the fragrances of the World to Come rise,"
which is fear of Heaven, corresponding to "we will hear"
is aroused and brings forth holy souls,"
and that is "we will hear" before "we will do."
שֶׁאָמַר כֵּיוָן דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְתַתָּא מְקַדְּשִׁין וְכוּלֵּי
that it says, "once Yisrael below sanctify…" and so on;
that is, at the very start of Shabbos,
to accept Shabbos at its onset;
and immediately the Tree of Life is aroused.
the Sages instituted Kiddush over wine,
and there is no Kiddush except where a meal is eaten,
"And you shall call the Shabbos a delight"
where the calling of Kiddush is,
That is, from the side of man
the main thing is fear of Heaven,
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
is only in fear of Heaven.
וְאַחַר כָּךְ וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב (תְּהִלִּים לד, טו)
Therefore immediately at the onset of Shabbos,
every one of Yisrael attains fear of Heaven,
which are in the secret of oneg,
the initials of Eden, Nahar, Gan,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א כו, א)
(as is written in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 55:
and that is the aspect of Atika;
And this is what the holy Zohar says,
"is aroused and brings forth holy souls…" and so on;
that is, at the time of the meal.
And this is why the holy Zohar was precise afterward
"And then all of Yisrael are crowned
all of them in joy, in repose"
that is, they merit the crowns
from "we will do" and "we will hear";
for even at the Friday night meal
which are the holiness of Shabbos;

New Souls and the Crowns of Eden

p: וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קנח, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (on this parshah, Zohar III 158b):
"And this you wanted first to know,
And this is in the manner of what is written
between Atika, the most hidden of all hidden,
when they thirsted and longed for water;
"According to their pasture, they were sated" (Hoshea 13:6);
and likewise in the Sifrei on Eikev they expounded:
"'And you shall eat and be sated;
שֶׁאֵין אָדָם מוֹרֵד בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
for a person does not rebel against HaKadosh Baruch Hu
as it says, "and you shall eat and be sated"
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קנד, ב)
And so it is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 154b):
"For the yetzer hara is found only
for drinking a lot of water.
כָּךְ הוּא דַּרְכָּהּ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה וְכוּלֵּי
"This is the way of Torah…" and so on,
"and water by measure you shall drink,"
are refined for the sake of Heaven;
and this is "Is Hashem in our midst,"
הַיְינוּ אַף שֶׁאֵין הַמְכֻוָּון לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם
that is, even when the intent is not for the sake of Heaven,
so that there will be light
For in the utterance of Bereishis
that is, so that there be light
And the reason they were punished for this
and acted by way of testing,"
as is written in the holy Zohar (Beshalach, there, II 64b).
the Sages instituted Kiddush over wine,
so that the drinking would be in holiness.
as is written in the holy Zohar (above, there),
so that it becomes the Tree of Life.
one merits at the meal the crowns,
and they are crowned with crowns
of the Field of Holy Apples,
"his fruit is sweet to my palate,"
as at the giving of the Torah,
when they put "we will do" before "we will hear."
And in truth Kiddush over wine itself
is not mentioned in the Torah,
only in the words of the Prophets;
רַק חֲכָמִים תִּקְּנוּ קִידּוּשׁ עַל הַיַּיִן
only the Sages instituted Kiddush over wine,
and that is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
is from the dew of Atika,
That is, "If your sins be like the years
from the six days of Creation
they shall be made white as snow"
that is, from the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil
which is the Tree of Life,

— “When they grazed, they were sated; When they were sated, they grew haughty; And so they forgot Me.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Shabbos 89b — “… ליה! אמר רבי יצחק, אמר להם הקדוש ברוך הוא לישראל: אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים הללו שסדורות ובאות מששת ימי בראשית ועד עכשיו — כשלג ילבינו. דרש רבא, מאי דכתיב: ״לכו …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 190) — “We learned in the mishna: From where is it derived that one ties a scarlet strip of wool to the scapegoat? As it says: “If your sins be like scarlet [kashanim], they will become white like snow” (Isaiah 1:18). The …”
